description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a bubblecloud graphics object.

tr.td: updates annotation metadata used by graphics tools.
Type: graphics annotation object or empty handle value. Supported values: an annotation object associated with the graphics item, or an empty graphics handle.
reports whether deletion is in progress.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls callback queuing while another callback runs.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue', 'cancel'.
runs when the object receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
lists child graphics primitives owned by the chart.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector or child handles.
attaches the menu used for context-click actions.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
runs when the object is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
stores the label used by legends and object identification.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets the bubble outline color.
Type: color value. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], or hexadecimal color.
sets the bubble fill color.
Type: color value or color keyword. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], hexadecimal color, or 'flat'.
stores grouping labels used to color bubbles and create legend entries.
Type: cell array of character rows. Supported values: empty cell array or one label per bubble.
stores the table variable used for grouping labels.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or a source-table variable name.
controls handle discovery through graphics queries.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
includes or excludes the object from mouse hit testing.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
stores the inner chart rectangle.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: four finite values [left bottom width height].
controls interruption of running callbacks.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
stores labels displayed inside bubbles.
Type: cell array of character rows. Supported values: empty cell array or one label per bubble.
stores the table variable used for bubble labels.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or a source-table variable name.
sets the title displayed above group legend entries.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector, string scalar, or empty text.
stores the outer chart rectangle.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: four finite values [left bottom width height].
stores the parent graphics container.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: figure handle.
controls which visible parts can be picked.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', 'none'.
stores the chart position rectangle.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: four finite values [left bottom width height].
controls selection state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls selection highlight display.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
stores numeric bubble sizes.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: finite numeric values.
stores the table variable used for bubble sizes.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or a source-table variable name.
stores the table used to create the chart.
Type: table or empty array. Supported values: [] or a table supplied to bubblecloud.
stores user-defined text for identifying the object.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets chart title text.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector, string scalar, or empty text.
identifies the graphics object type.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'bubblecloud'.
sets units used by position properties.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'normalized', 'pixels', 'inches', 'centimeters', 'points', 'characters'.
stores user data attached to the chart.
Type: any Nelson value. Supported values: any value.
controls chart visibility.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
